# Google Videos
> Search millions of videos from across the web.

Google Videos is Google's video search experience, helping users discover video content from across the web through Google Search. The domain is also widely used for Google-hosted video delivery infrastructure and related media endpoints.

## Search
- [Google Videos Home](https://www.google.com/videohp): Main Google Videos search homepage for discovering videos across the web.
- [Google Search](https://www.google.com/): Primary Google search interface, including video search results and filters.
- [Video Search Results](https://www.google.com/search?tbm=vid): Google Search video vertical showing video-specific search results.
- [Google Trends](https://trends.google.com/): Explore trending topics and queries that may surface popular video searches.

## Help Center
- [Google Search Help](https://support.google.com/websearch): Official help center for Google Search features, settings, and troubleshooting.
- [Search Results Help](https://support.google.com/websearch/topic/3378866): Guidance on understanding and using Google Search results pages.
- [Search Privacy Help](https://support.google.com/websearch/topic/3081620): Information about privacy controls and data handling in Search.
- [Google Account Help](https://support.google.com/accounts): Help for account settings that affect personalized search experiences.

## Search Console
- [Google Search Console](https://search.google.com/search-console/about): Tools for site owners to monitor indexing and search performance.
- [Video Indexing Report](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9495631): Documentation for monitoring how Google indexes videos on websites.
- [Video Structured Data](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/video): Structured data guidance for making video content eligible in Search.
- [Video SEO Best Practices](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/video): Best practices for helping Google find, understand, and show videos.

## Search Central Documentation
- [Google Search Central](https://developers.google.com/search): Main documentation hub for Google Search and indexing guidance.
- [Search Essentials](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/creating-helpful-content): Core guidance for creating useful, searchable content for Google Search.
- [Crawling and Indexing](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing): Documentation on how Google discovers and indexes web content.
- [Sitemaps](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/sitemaps/overview): Overview of sitemap usage for improving content discovery.
- [Video Sitemaps](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/sitemaps/video-sitemaps): Sitemap extensions specifically for video content discovery.

## Developer Resources
- [Google Developers](https://developers.google.com/): Central hub for Google developer products, APIs, and technical documentation.
- [Programmable Search Engine](https://programmablesearchengine.google.com/about/): Custom search tools for building search experiences on websites.
- [Google APIs Explorer](https://developers.google.com/apis-explorer): Interactive interface for exploring supported Google APIs.
- [Google Cloud Media CDN](https://cloud.google.com/media-cdn): Content delivery platform relevant to large-scale media and video distribution.
- [Google Cloud Transcoder API](https://cloud.google.com/transcoder): API for transforming video files into streaming-ready formats.

## Publisher Guidance
- [Video Best Practices](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/video): Recommendations for making video pages eligible for rich search features.
- [Thumbnail Guidelines](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/google-discover#images): Image and preview guidance relevant to rich surfaces and previews.
- [Live Badge for Videos](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/video#live-badge): Structured data guidance for live video indicators in Search.
- [Clip Structured Data](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/video#clip): Mark up key moments and clips within videos for Search.
- [SeekToAction Markup](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/video#seektoaction): Enable key moments using SeekToAction structured data markup.

## Policies
- [Google Search Spam Policies](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/essentials/spam-policies): Policies governing spam and manipulative behavior in Google Search.
- [Google Search Content Policies](https://support.google.com/websearch/answer/10622781): Overview of content-related limitations and policy enforcement in Search.
- [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy): Google's privacy policy covering data collection and usage.
- [Google Terms of Service](https://policies.google.com/terms): Terms governing use of Google products and services.

## Related Google Video Products
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/): Google's primary video platform for hosting, discovery, and streaming.
- [YouTube Help](https://support.google.com/youtube): Official help center for YouTube users, creators, and viewers.
- [YouTube for Developers](https://developers.google.com/youtube): Developer documentation for YouTube APIs and integrations.
- [Google TV](https://tv.google/): Google product for discovering and watching movies and shows across services.
